panels.summary: Slice S4c (PRD_VIEWER_UX 4.7-4.9). New pure src/projects/node/panels.ts (reviewer time/deadline, blocking findings, challenge headline, handoff wait from receipts, approval line, integrated commit, section entries) with tests/unit/panels.test.ts (7 tests). NodeDetail now holds the review resource (ReviewDetail's former key and fallback; also loaded for the approval's bundle), builds the review/challenge index entries, renders the challenge headline and passes node, events, spans, inputs and review to the controller sections; ReviewPanel no longer fetches. Review: blocking cards (blocking-finding, outside review-findings) before the table, reviewer-time beside reviewer-status (took / launch time not recorded (print) / no verdict · launched), findings table restyled as cards at <=760px. Challenge: one headline, record folded, P0/P1 open, P2 one line each. Controller: handoff-summary with wait from receipts, approval-summary with ≈ and 'no approval event recorded' plus bundle, integrate-summary with branch, commit and 'no push performed', awaiting-since on AwaitingNotice. Fixtures in fixtures/ux-review.ts for both phases (parity with the real RunStore checked by a throwaway script), spec ux-review.spec.ts with the three scenarios. Red first: unit 7/7 failed on a skeleton; browser 3/3 failed in both phases (soft-copy list in docs/handoff/ux-s4c.md). Green, executed: npm run build ok; npm run lint clean; npx tsx --test tests/unit/panels.test.ts 7 passed; npm run test:unit 278 passed; playwright worker and candidate: ux-review review reviewers guardrails projects ux-node ux-run clarity lanes inputs 45 passed each, ux-verify ux-launch ux-time 9 passed each; JSON report of ux-review.spec.ts in both phases passed workflow check-report. No commits.
open_assumptions: Per-reviewer live elapsed time and deadline are not rendered (decisions.md deferral); reviewerDeadline/deadlineText exist and are unit-tested only.
The blocking card links the requirement in the lane's task, not a file location (the review records none); no [More] on P2 table rows.
Review index lists Blocking N (only when N>0) and Findings N; no Diff entry (S7). Challenge index lists Concerns N and Alternative & experiment.
An automatic run's approval without an event is worded 'approved automatically by the finish policy (<finish>)', a manual one 'approved by the operator'; its instant is triage's (≈ the integration).
awaiting-since is shown only when the waiting node has a status row; the manual approval command comes from deriveNow in node-next.
Challenge styles are in node/review.css since no challenge stylesheet is in the lane's owned paths.

lists.summary: Slice S6: Runs home at /projects (Needs you by served activity.attention.kind question/pane/approval, Running, Recent = finished within 7 days newest first, compact project cards) from run lists only; RunRow (one link in an li, data-run-id/data-status/data-attention, name starts with run id, stacks at 390 px); project page grouped by feature under workflows-list; feature page keeps run-list li rows with Current definition in a closed details; reordered workflow title rule; ServedRunContext from ProjectsView feeds LiveStatus (controller suffix, not_running only after 15 s), CommandBlock (RUN=<run_dir> line) and NowBanner (served question/answered/controller-stopped re-derivation). Pure helpers in src/projects/lists.ts with 27 unit tests. Fixtures ux-lists.ts (8 runs, live ui.questions.json, pane event, dead controller PID, viewer.expose_run_dir); ux-lists.spec.ts with [scenario:runs-home] and [scenario:served-activity]; projects.spec.ts:149 migrated (open the current-definition summary). Red recorded first in both phases (unit: module missing; browser: no needs-you rows, banner showed the export's stale question). Executed and green: npm run build; npm run lint; npx tsx --test tests/unit/lists.test.ts (27/27); npm run test:unit (298/298); npx tsx --test server/projects.test.ts (52/52); ux-lists.spec.ts + projects.spec.ts worker and candidate (12/12 each, JSON reports pass workflow check-report for lists); full project-workflows suite worker 53/53 and candidate 53/53. Handoff: docs/handoff/ux-s6.md. Nothing committed.
open_assumptions: When served activity disagrees with the export (question answered or asked in the live questions file, or controller not running for 15 s while running), NowBanner re-derives from served fields alone (deriveNow with no events), so that banner lacks the event-derived reason and the question number/text; document.title, graph and Steps attention still use RunView's export-derived attention because RunView is not edited.
A run page titles a generic-named workflow by its own run's activity.feature (it reads no run list); lists and the feature page use the latest run's feature.
Needs you is sorted longest waiting first, Running by latest activity; the PRD does not specify order.
The project page shows the first run page per workflow ('N+ runs' when more exist) and runs of any age; its heading reads '<project>: features'.
Runs home pages each workflow's runs only while the last run read is inside the 7-day window, so an old still-running run on a later page is listed only on its project and feature pages.
